headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 5, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs with a 17-1 victory, led by Masyn Winn's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. The New York Yankees took down the Minnesota Twins 5-2, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with the Colorado Rockies placing Tomoyuki Sugano and Seth Halvorsen on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms and right shoulder inflammation, respectively. The San Francisco Giants have placed Matt Gage on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow strain. The Atlanta Braves have placed Ha-Seong Kim on the 10-day injured list with right middle finger inflammation. The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed Evan Sisk on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. The Texas Rangers have placed Jakob Junis on the 15-day injured list with left hip impingement. The San Diego Padres have placed Freddy Fermin on the 10-day injured list with a head contusion and Randy Vásquez on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle contusion.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Baltimore Orioles traded Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, securing a 17-1 victory. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 7-1 victory. Bryan Reynolds and Braxton Ashcraft led the way for the Pirates, with Reynolds contributing at the plate and Ashcraft delivering a strong performance on the mound.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees in Dominant 11-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a convincing win over the New York Yankees, outscoring them 11-4. Trevor Larnach and Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense, contributing to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Sugano Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tomoyuki Sugano has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms, effective retroactive to July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes as part of a recent trade involving the Guardians.
